editedExercise.name: Cross-Body Arm Swings

instructions.description: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly relaxed, and core gently engaged. Extend both arms straight forward at about chest height.
Slowly swing your arms out to the sides, opening your chest. Allow your shoulder blades to move naturally toward each other and feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring your arms back toward the center in a controlled movement, allowing them to cross comfortably in front of your body.
Continue alternating the crossing position, keeping the movement smooth and relaxed without forcing the range of motion.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count controlled movement repetitions through a comfortable range of motion.

commentsNotes: Keep your chest open and shoulders relaxed throughout.
Cross your arms only as far as comfortable—no need to force the stretch.
